meta.title: North Carolina sewer-system permits with no public owner on DWR's overflow layers: the permittee
meta.method: Every collection-system permit (WQCS..., WQCSD...) on the DWR Sanitary Sewer Overflow layers (2026 and September 2022 to December 2025) whose owner is not a public body on the history layer, or which appears only on the 2026 layer (no owner field), looked up in DWR's Water Quality Permitting document repository (Laserfiche WebLink, folder DWR - Water Quality Permitting / <regional office> / Collection System / <permit>): the Owner field of the permit's newest document that has one. A permittee who is an individual is never named; the row names the facility. EPA plant permits with no row come from EPA ICIS-NPDES.
meta.legal_basis: G.S. 143-215.1C(b) binds 'the owner or operator of any wastewater collection or treatment works' primarily for municipal or domestic wastewater with a permit under the Part (press release at 1,000 gallons to surface water; newspaper notice at 15,000), and (c) the same for other works' untreated waste: private owners are bound like public ones.
meta.notes: Built by hand from the lookups; scripts/add_nc_operators.py reads it.
